action:
After a standard system update you need to restart YADIFA to make all the
necessary changes.
description:
It was discovered that YADIFA did not check for infinite pointer loops when
parsing DNS packets. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to
cause YADIFA to consume excessive CPU resources, leading to a denial of
service.
isummary:
YADIFA could be made to consume excessive resources if it received
specially crafted network traffic.
title: YADIFA vulnerability
